kind: QA-only source-based proposed single-endpoint colour descriptions for 16 retained F1 Food Tests result cases

methodNote: Use suitable heated Benedict conditions; no exact nutrient concentration or quantitative ranking should be inferred from these colours. AQA examples are suggested methods, not TGS-specific evidence.
scopeReview: TGS Year 8 science teaching and independent sole-key plus all distractors still pending
